name: Pendulum Squat
summary: A machine-based squat variation utilizing a counterbalanced arc trajectory to heavily load the quadriceps while reducing spinal compression.

setup: Step onto the footplate and rest your shoulders snugly under the shoulder pads with your back firmly pressed against the backrest.
Position your feet shoulder-width apart in the middle or lower half of the platform depending on your limb lengths and mobility.
Grasp the machine handles, extend your knees and hips to unrack the carriage, and disengage the safety catch.
steps: Inhale and brace your core, keeping your torso firmly supported against the pad.
Descend smoothly along the machine's arc by flexing your knees and hips, allowing your knees to track forward over your toes.
Lower until your thighs reach at least parallel to the footplate or full knee flexion without your lower back rounding off the pad.
Drive through your midfoot and heels, extending your knees and hips to return to the starting position without locking out abruptly.
Re-engage the safety mechanism once your set is complete.
instructions.breathing: Inhale deeply and brace your core before descending; exhale as you press out of the bottom and approach the top of the repetition.
cues: Stay glued to the back pad
Track your knees over your toes

common_faults.fault: Lifting the lower back or pelvis off the support pad at the bottom.
common_faults.correction: Limit your depth to what your hip mobility allows and ensure your back stays flat against the pad throughout.

common_faults.fault: Letting the heels rise off the platform.
common_faults.correction: Move your foot placement slightly higher on the platform or focus on driving through the whole foot.

common_faults.fault: Bouncing out of the bottom reversal point.
common_faults.correction: Control the eccentric descent and pause momentarily at deep knee flexion before driving up.

precautions: Ensure the mechanical safety stops are adjusted to a safe minimum height before loading heavy weights.
Always confirm the safety latch is fully engaged before stepping out of the machine.
